Build the body that writes the Entra account of a row into the register

entra_id_payload.Rd

A fifth door beside the outcome, the identity, the owner and the seal (item 11 of the 0.27.0), and for the same reason: the columns are fixed here so a bug cannot rewrite anything else. The value is the id of the Entra account the row was first carried out for, as the sweep reads it.

Usage

entra_id_payload(record_id, entra_id)

Arguments

record_id

The register record to write to.

entra_id

The account's identifier, or "".

Value

A one-row data frame with exactly record_id and applied_entra_id.

Details

An empty value is accepted, unlike the owner's: the round writes one only just before the value itself, when the field already shows the value and the log holds no write of the channel's (log_channel_entra_id()), since REDCap logs no write that leaves a field as it was.
